packages.role: official compiler; test-only conformance oracle, never executed by a product path
React component provider (MDXProvider, useMDXComponents); the providerImportSource MDX-with-React activation requires
MDXProps / MDXContent / MDXComponents / MDXModule declarations; the native props facet source

reactProfile.note: MDX0 records no React version of its own. The one React profile is RCT0's; MDX1M-AC6 rejects any React pin here that differs from RCT0's lock.

nextMajor.rule: A next MDX major (4.x) is admitted only once announced upstream and ratified by an MDX0 amendment; until then an installed 4.x resolves to unsupported-version.

excluded.reason: next major not yet announced and ratified by an MDX0 amendment
floating and prerelease tags are never admitted

notes: Pins are the current 3.x line of each package at ratification, read from the npm registry; integrities are the registry dist.integrity values. Activation compares the PM-resolved installed version against this lock (VID0 R08), never the declared range.
